title: On a continuity method for Dirichlet problem of Hessian equations
summary: In this paper, we develop a continuity method for the Dirichlet problem of Hessian equations on Riemannian manifolds. Such equations, introduced by Caffarelli, Nirenberg and Spruck, are defined in terms of the eigenvalues of the Hessian and a given pair $(f,Γ)$, where $f$ is a symmetric function defined in a symmetric cone $Γ\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, and $Γ$ specifies the set of admissible eigenvalues for the solution.
